Enum Class Conversions.Checkcasts

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Conversions.Checkcasts>
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.core.Conversions.Checkcasts
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Conversions.Checkcasts>, Constable
Enclosing class:
Conversions
public static enum Conversions.Checkcasts extends Enum<Conversions.Checkcasts>
Which checkcasts of a conversion are left out as redundant. The two writers differ, and each keeps its own: the ASM writer's output is compared instruction by instruction, and the JDK writer leaves out every cast its erasure makes redundant to keep generated methods well inside the 64KB limit.
Since:
2.3

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ERASURE
    The JDK writer's: a value is cast unless its erasure is the target's, or the target is Object.
    MODEL
    The ASM writer's: a reference is cast unless the model knows its type to be the target's or assignable to it, and a boxed value unless its wrapper is the target type itself - even Object.
